title: Full diagonal outcome distributions preserve the sharp missing-cell mean rectangle under monotonicity
checked_scope: Bounded two-program potential outcomes with individual coordinatewise monotonicity and known complete diagonal marginal distributions.
significance: Resolves a richer-data sharpness case: stochastic dominance is the exact compatibility condition, and the source's mean rectangle remains attainable even with both diagonal laws fixed.
